title: Vivy: Fluorite Eye's Song - To Make Everyone Happy With My Singing
content:
Yet one of those mid-season recap episodes. I know these come with a lot of negativity, but hear me out, if you’re watching it at the right time, they always provide a great bundle of value.

I’m not going to pull too many strands off this, it does its job by refreshing your memory of what has happened in the show so far and doesn’t offer anything new or exciting. It’s basically a compilation of clips edited together that fit like Lego pieces.

It’s not a bad recap by any means, yet it remains forgettable.
I re-iterate, this is a great option for those who want a refresher or those who are coming back into the show after a hiatus (like me fr).
